recommendations.title: Create a Defa Power vs Zaptec/Easee comparison page
recommendations.details: Write a new comparison article that adds Defa Power (specific consumer EV charger models) alongside Zaptec Go 2 and Easee Up. Include a side‑by‑side table with: max AC power (per phase and total), MID‑metering status, built‑in RCD type (A / 6 mA DC), IT‑network compatibility, ability to charge on solar surplus (native or via accessories), connectivity (4G, LTE‑M, Wi‑Fi, Bluetooth, OCPP support), load balancing / equalizer support, dimensions, IP/IK rating, warranty, and typical installation requirements. Add a short guidance section: "Which to choose" covering common homeowner scenarios (need for MID billing, poor Wi‑Fi coverage, IT‑network, solar optimisation). Provide pricing band estimates and typical installation tasks (need for separate RCD, main fuse upgrade, cabling).
